_comment: A source archive with no build process, whose shipped background.js is packed and so is NOT the archive's code. The build's entry point is the root package.json, and there is none, so sca-package-file-missing rejects it and names review-early-exit, withholding the ask sections. The finding carries no locus - it is about a file the archive does NOT contain, unlike its sibling sca-package-file-invalid, which anchors at the manifest it could not read. The shipped bytes NOT being the archive's is incidental here rather than a condition: this check reports an absent manifest either way, and what the XPI-only advice does about it is pinned by sca-not-required-broken-build.
